report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry is healthy: gateway/order/payment/inventory error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, and the order trace completed OK at 1050ms. Order shows retained heap after GC with WARN logs, but a single window cannot establish a leak. No evidence supports a bounded root cause; hand off for more data.
missing_evidence: Current error-rate/latency telemetry showing the alert condition (all admitted metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 72ms)
Order service memory-retention time series to distinguish a leak from a transient retained-heap warning
Trace spans for downstream payment/inventory calls to assess downstream latency
Deployment records for the alert window to assess version-related regressions
